project_type: .NET 8 WPF desktop app (Windows). Multi-project solution: Core (no WPF) + Presenter (WPF UserControls/Windows) + UI (app entry) + Audio + Tests.
language: C# (net8.0 for Core/Tests, net8.0-windows WPF for Presenter/UI). Nullable enabled, ImplicitUsings enabled.
build_system: dotnet SDK / MSBuild via WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln. Presenter uses the WPF SDK default XAML globbing, so adding .xaml/.xaml.cs files needs NO csproj edit. Tests already reference Core via <ProjectReference>; Core helpers need no new <Compile Include> links. Baseline is GREEN: build 0 errors (4 pre-existing warnings), tests 460 passing.
test_framework: xUnit 2.6.6 with Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.8.0 in WorshipPlayer.Tests (net8.0). Pattern: [Fact] methods, temp-folder tests implement IDisposable and delete the temp dir (see ServiceOrderPersistenceTests.cs).
verification_instructions: 1) Build Core alone for Core-only changes: dotnet build WorshipPlayer.Core/WorshipPlayer.Core.csproj. 2) Run tests: dotnet test WorshipPlayer.Tests/WorshipPlayer.Tests.csproj (must stay green, 460+ passing). 3) For WPF changes build the whole solution: dotnet build WorshipBacktrackPlayer.sln -c Debug. 4) CRITICAL launch/crash check (three prior crashes were at OperatorWindow open): dotnet run --project WorshipPlayer.UI, confirm the operator window opens on the Home screen WITHOUT a load-time crash and with no white-on-white theming, then close cleanly. The app flow is WorshipPlayer.UI MainWindow -> PresenterIntegration.ShowOperatorWindow -> new OperatorWindow() -> Initialize(engine, output, theme, display, saveCb) -> Show().
environment_constraints: Windows-only WPF (Presenter/UI target net8.0-windows). The Tests project cannot reference the WPF Presenter project, so all unit-testable logic MUST live in WorshipPlayer.Core. OperatorWindow.xaml deliberately uses NO resource dictionaries and NO {StaticResource}; adding either risks the DependencyProperty.UnsetValue / StackOverflow crash seen three times. dotnet run opens real windows; close them to let the command exit.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist. README documents the .NET 8 / WPF / NAudio stack and build/run commands. Follow the finalized design at .agents/tasks/home-services-screens/design.md as authoritative. No new NuGet dependencies. No JSON schema changes. Commit locally on the current branch; never push.
key_patterns: A WPF UserControl/Window that needs the dark theme merges it inside its own Resources via <ResourceDictionary Source="pack://application:,,,/WorshipPlayer.Presenter;component/Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml"/> (see ServiceInfoDialog.xaml) and applies keyed styles explicitly (Style="{StaticResource OwcAccentButton}" etc.). OperatorWindow.xaml does the OPPOSITE: hardcoded inline brushes only. Center panels in OperatorWindow Row-3/Col-1 content Grid overlap and are toggled by Visibility (ServicesPanel is a <Grid>; SongsPanel/ScripturePanel/MediaPanel are <Border>+<ContentPresenter>). SwitchToTab(string) hides all then shows one. Views are passive renderers: SetServices(rows) in, typed events out; the host owns all mutations and re-scans via Core after each. VERIFIED theme keys (use EXACTLY these): brushes OwcBackgroundBrush, OwcPanelBrush, OwcSurfaceBrush, OwcSurfaceHoverBrush, OwcAccentBrush, OwcTextPrimaryBrush, OwcTextSecondaryBrush, OwcTextMutedBrush, OwcBorderBrush; styles OwcTextBox, OwcDarkComboBox, OwcButtonBase, OwcAccentButton, OwcPanelBorder. Names WITHOUT the Brush suffix (OwcTextPrimary, OwcPanel, OwcSurfaceHover) DO NOT EXIST and throw at load.

directory_structure: WorshipPlayer.Core/{Models,Services}: data models + cross-platform logic (listing/formatting helpers go here for testability). WorshipPlayer.Presenter/{Themes,Views,Services}: WPF; Themes/OwcDesignSystem.xaml holds all keyed brushes/styles; Views/ holds OperatorWindow (the main window, no resource dictionaries) and feature panels/UserControls (Views/Home for HomeView, Views/ServiceBuilder for ServicesListView + ServiceInfoDialog). WorshipPlayer.UI: app entry (MainWindow) + PresenterIntegration that constructs/launches OperatorWindow. WorshipPlayer.Tests: xUnit tests (net8.0) referencing Core; some Presenter service .cs files are linked in via <Compile Include> but WPF views are NOT testable there.
